# Measures & References {.unnumbered}

All measures are drawn from existing, validated instruments, with one documented exception:
the Chapter 7 Feedback Orientation items are author-created for this course (no validated
bipolar supportive/corrective scale exists). See the companion strategy document (*FRI PM
Mindsets Strategy*) for the full item bank, scoring, and access status.

## Measure by chapter

| Chapter | Mindset | Instrument · subscale | Access |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3 | Sem 3 Peer Mentors | Single-item commitment to becoming a more effective mentor (author-created) | Author-created |
| 4 | Mentoring Style | Mentoring Style Values Inventory (adapted from Ertesvåg, 2011); Mentoring Competency Assessment (Fleming et al., 2013) | Adapted · Free |
| 5 | Motivational Style | Mentoring Regulatory Focus 2×2 (adapted; Higgins, 1997; Lockwood et al., 2002) | Adapted |
| 6 | Leadership Focus | Promotion/Prevention Team Leadership Scale (adapted) | Adapted |
| 7 | Feedback Orientation | Feedback Orientation, bipolar (author-created for this course) | Author-created |
| 8 | People Orientation | 'Kind of Person' Implicit Theory Scale (Dweck, 1999) | Free |
| 9 | Leadership Role | Mentoring Leadership Functions inventory (adapted from Morgeson, DeRue & Karam, 2010) | Adapted |
| 10 | Communication Style | Nonviolent Communication Behaviors Scale (Cheung et al., 2022) | © |
| 11 | Inclusive Mentoring | Culturally Aware Mentorship Self-Efficacy (Byars-Winston & Butz, 2021) | Free *(proposed)* |
| 12 | Conflict Style | Dutch Test for Conflict Handling (DUTCH), short form (De Dreu et al., 2001) | Free (© article) |
| 13 | Self-Awareness | Eurich four-type framework — self-classification, no measure (Eurich, 2017, 2018) | Free (framework) |

**Access legend.** Free = freely available for research and education. © = copyrighted, items
typically in the source article, free for non-commercial research with citation (verify terms).
Licensed = commercially licensed, purchase or permission required. Adapted = adapted from a
copyrighted instrument (cite the original).

::: {.callout-note}
## Not measured this semester
The pretest does not include **Goal Preference**, **Facilitator**, or **Facilitator
Reflection**, so those mindsets are not part of this guide. The Five-Dimensional Curiosity
Scale (Kashdan et al., 2020), the Mentor Self-Efficacy Scale, and the Paradox Mindset Scale
(Miron-Spektor et al., 2018) are likewise parked. Their item banks are retained in the strategy
document in case a chapter is reassigned.
:::

::: {.callout-important}
## How two scores are scaled
- **Feedback Orientation** is collected on a 1–7 bipolar scale where 4 = Balanced. Chapter 7
  subtracts 4 to re-centre it, so your reported score runs from −3 to +3 with 0 as balanced.
- **Leadership Role** counts *"evaluate the performance of the team"* as a **Task** function,
  giving five Task and five Relational functions. Because the ten share a fixed 50-point budget,
  the two totals are complements of each other.
:::
